statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let I := fun (n:ℕ) (a b:ℕ→ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => S n a u*S n b u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let Λ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt; let μ := fun d : ℕ => ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℝ); let U := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n : ℝ) ^ (1 / 6 : ℝ)⌋₊; let u := fun (n m : ℕ) => if m ^ 3 ≤ n then 0 else (∑ d ∈ (Nat.divisors m).filter (fun d => d ≤ U n), μ d * Real.log ((m / d : ℕ) : ℝ)) - (∑ d ∈ (Nat.divisors m).filter (fun d => d ≤ U n), μ d * ∑ l ∈ (Nat.divisors (m / d)).filter (fun l => l ≤ U n), Λ l); let v := fun (n m : ℕ) => if m ^ 3 ≤ n then 0 else ∑ a ∈ (Nat.divisors m).filter (fun a => U n < m / a), (∑ d ∈ (Nat.divisors a).filter (fun d => U n < d), μ d) * Λ (m / a); let highLambda := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k ^ 3 ≤ n then 0 else Λ k; (∀ n m : ℕ, highLambda n m = u n m + v n m) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, I n (highLambda n) (highLambda n) = I n (u n) (u n) + 2 * I n (u n) (v n) + I n (v n) (v n))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 高段次弧 · MA-7010 · 立方根高段上的 Vaughan 精确分拆
plain_statement.en: New route · High-segment minor arcs · MA-7010 · Exact Vaughan split on the cube-root high segment

brief.zh: 取截断 U=⌊n^(1/6)⌋，在 m³>n 上因 m>U 使 Λ_{≤U}(m)=0，由 Vaughan 卷积恒等式精确分解高段 von Mangoldt 权为 u+v，并拆分旧次弧积分 I(h_Λ,h_Λ)。
brief.en: With cutoff U=⌊n^(1/6)⌋, every m with m³>n satisfies m>U so Λ_{≤U}(m)=0, giving the exact Vaughan decomposition highLambda=u+v and bilinear expansion of I(highLambda,highLambda) on (arcs n)ᶜ.
